sources.title: Qwen 3.5 9B - AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B is a post-trained vision-language model with 9B parameters, 32 layers, and a Gated DeltaNet plus Gated Attention hybrid layout, built for multimodal instruction-following and tool calling, with 262,144 native context length and stated extensibility up to about 1,010,000 tokens.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B | Awesome Agents
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B is the largest model in the Qwen 3.5 Small Series and arguably the most impressive for what it hits relative to its size. At 9 billion parameters, it beats the previous generation's Qwen3-30B on most language benchmarks and dominates GPT-5-Nano and Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite on vision tasks by double-digit margins.

sources.title: Qwen: Qwen3.5-9B - AI Model Details & Benchmarks
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B, a multimodal foundation model from qwen, demonstrates a strong overall reliability with an 83% success rate across benchmarks, indicating consistent operational stability. However, its speed performance is a notable area for improvement, ranking in the 10th percentile, suggesting longer response times compared to peers.

sources.title: Qwen 3.5 9B — Models — The AI Bench
sources.snippet: Strongest "runs on a mid-tier GPU" model in the Qwen 3.5 small line — supports thinking mode and 201-language coverage. Fits 8 GB VRAM with headroom.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B - AI Model | Apertis AI
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B is a multimodal foundation model from the Qwen3.5 family, built to deliver strong reasoning, coding, and visual understanding within an efficient 9B-parameter architecture. It adopts a unified vision-language design with early fusion of multimodal tokens, enabling the model to process and reason across text and images within the same context.
